purpose: Visual and UX reference for OPD1 Tracker. Stack, API contracts, and repository architecture remain governed by AGENTS.md and the source.

ui.usage: Segoe UI body and controls at 14px, secondary labels 12px. Bahnschrift for headings and tabular numbers; Arabic falls back to Segoe UI.

outcome_score.usage: Tabular numerals for scores and telemetry.

ascii.usage: ASCII Studio content and controls only.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use border-edge; stronger borders for focused surfaces.
visual_enhancers.translucency: Original charcoal surfaces, original player-card art with local text gradients; preserve full-color profile maps and skins.

component_guidance.list_rows: Two real team rosters. Dedicated full-color artwork rail with agent portrait; no artwork behind text. Statistics are the default; the shared Statistics/Loadouts switch replaces statistics with all four real weapon slots at the owner request. Equal recent-result markers read newest first with native accessible descriptions. Compact cards at fixed size; columns rearrange when maximized.
component_guidance.drawer: Centered profile workspace up to 1120px, with independent body scroll, a featured loadout first, two overview columns, full-color map thumbnails, and embedded match detail preserving drafts and focus.
component_guidance.modal: Match details render in a dialog modal in HistoryView (MatchDetailModal) while sharing the identical MatchDetailContent view when embedded within PlayerDrawer, ensuring fixed column alignment, accessible truncation, and draft persistence across view transitions.
component_guidance.outcomes: Keep win, loss, draw, and unresolved distinct. Use OutcomeBadge sizes consistently.
component_guidance.player_names: Truncate long names without displacing rank. Keep the complete name in the profile opener accessible label and native title.
component_guidance.alerts: Heuristic indicators with accessible qualified labels and detailed reasons in the player profile. Actual rank and party colors remain independent.
component_guidance.texture: Use real VALORANT artwork. contour.png is a generated decorative fallback when the profile card is unavailable; it never represents game data.

accessibility.interactive: Provide visible focus rings, collision-aware overlays, Escape/outside-click closing, and focus restoration.

media.valorant_assets: Load VALORANT imagery only from media.valorant-api.com.
media.fonts: Use Windows system fonts; no runtime font requests.

design_notes_for_agents: Do not change the Flask backend for visual redesign work.
Every interactive element and key informational wrapper must have a data-testid.
Design Mode must remain guarded by import.meta.env.DEV.
Real data only; demo payloads must never be presented as live data.
